name: Danny Fencing
addr: 40 N Capitol Ave, San Jose, CA 95127

description: Fence contractor specialising exclusively in redwood: new installs, replacement and repair, board-on-board construction, screws instead of nails, solar caps, 7-ft privacy with lattice, and a 10-year workmanship warranty.

Rot-cut repairs that save a panel run.
Sealing schedules so the colour stays.
